final_assessment: Worked out which judgements qualify for a readiness slot, per R-crc-7: mechanism first, as a decision table, executed against a real trail rather than a constructed one. ONE test decides it — is the judgement FORMED AGAINST INDEPENDENT REVIEW OUTPUT? Its value is not tidiness: citing the passes is the same property exit (3) makes checkable, so the qualifying criterion and the enforceable constraint turn out to be one thing. A judgement citing no pass has no ordering to check, which is exactly why it does not belong. Executed against all ELEVEN judgements rc02c's cycle actually made, read off the archived trail: FOUR qualify — apply over an unpassed gate, buy a scoped pass over a PASSED gate, accept the 58% residual, and believe the work is ready. The test earns its keep by what it EXCLUDES: six readiness-adjacent judgements are not readiness, and two are provably misplaced today — the size-overage acceptance is a method call misfiled into warnings, and the sync ratification is recorded nowhere at all. Neither is rc04's to fix, and saying so prevents the stage absorbing them. The qualifying four take TWO shapes rather than four, splitting by when they are formed: CONTINUATION (mid-cadence, given what came back what next, with dispositions proceed and spend) and TERMINAL (the readiness assertion, with the accepted residuals as its CONTENT rather than peer judgements). Two findings fall out. First, this ANSWERS exit criterion (4): gate_overridden gains a reader by becoming the negative case of the continuation slot — same shape, opposite disposition — so rc04 generalises it rather than adding a record beside it. Second, a defect that constrains the design: gate_overridden cites its pass in PROSE, not by token, so exit (3)'s ordering check could not run against it even today. The slot must cite by TOKEN with prose beside it rather than instead of it. Also settled in passing: routing an expansion to architecture needs no new home, being per-FINDING and already structured by the walk's decision lane. What remains open is the slot's field shape, and one scope call — whether rc04 ships both shapes or only the terminal assertion the charter names. Standing recommendation is both, because the terminal assertion cites continuation decisions as its reasons and structuring half of that leaves the citation dangling in prose. Under D-rc04-3 as amended that is a recommendation for Sal, not a call the AI makes.
